title: silene conica subsp. sartorii
intro: Silene conica subsp. sartorii, commonly known as the mountain catchfly, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The health benefits of Silene conica subsp. sartorii include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the management of infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal agent, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of Silene conica subsp. sartorii include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
